title: Suspended account
lesson: Urgency, a lookalike sender, a raw IP link, and a password ask. The domain is reserved.
subject: URGENT!!! Your PayPal account is suspended!!!
body: Dear customer, unusual activity was noted and the account is suspended. Verify your account and enter your password at https://203.0.113.44/login/44 within 2 hours or the account will be closed. This is a final notice.

title: Invoice pressure
lesson: A payment ask with a Reply-To on a different domain and a documentation IP address.
subject: Overdue invoice 4418
body: Please confirm payment details for overdue invoice 4418. Enter your password at https://198.51.100.23/invoice/18 to release the payment. A wire transfer is also accepted.

title: Gift-card prize
lesson: Shouty subject, a shortener-style host on a reserved domain, and a gift-card code ask.
subject: CONGRATULATIONS!!! YOU WON A $500 GIFT CARD!!!
body: You were selected for a limited time reward of a $500 gift card. Act now. Open https://bitly.example/r/1042 and send the codes from the card. Failure to respond forfeits the prize.

title: Fake help desk
lesson: The display name says Northwind IT, but the mailbox is a free webmail address.
subject: Action required: directory password
body: This is the IT helpdesk. Verify your account and enter your password at https://northwind-verify.example/reset/24. Failure to respond within 24 hours will leave the mailbox deactivated.

title: Lookalike sign-in
lesson: Quieter wording. The sender domain imitates Microsoft instead of shouting.
subject: Microsoft sign-in check
body: Hello Priya, Microsoft needs you to confirm your identity. Open https://micr0soft-secure.example/login/24 and enter your password. The check is due within 24 hours.

title: Class announcement
lesson: A professor, a matching school domain, and a course link. No secret and no payment.
subject: CS 484 office hours Thursday
body: Office hours are Thursday 14:00-16:00 in Room 210. The decision-tree homework is posted on https://canvas.northwind.edu/courses/484. Bring one question. No reply is required if you are on track.

title: Bookstore receipt
lesson: The store name and the sending domain agree, and the note records a payment that already happened.
subject: Bookstore receipt 48219
body: Thanks for your order 48219. Item: course reader. Amount paid: $42.15. You can view it at https://bookstore.northwind.edu/orders/48219. This mailbox is unattended.

title: Calm IT note
lesson: A real security reminder can mention passwords without asking for one, and it points at the campus site.
subject: Account reminder from Northwind IT
body: Northwind IT is writing with a routine reminder. Staff will not ask you to send a password by email. If you want to review your account, type https://accounts.northwind.edu into your browser yourself. No reply is required.

title: Urgent repair
lesson: The word urgent is real facilities mail here. The sender matches the school and nothing asks for a secret.
subject: Facilities notice: water shutoff tonight
body: Facilities notice: there is an urgent water shutoff in the engineering building tonight from 22:00 to 23:00. No action is needed. The lab will reopen in the morning. Status page: https://status.northwind.edu/facilities.

title: Quoted in class
lesson: A professor quotes a fake message for class. Bag-of-words features still see the quoted ask, so the model can call a real email phishing.
subject: CYEN 301 reading for Thursday
body: On Thursday we will read a clumsy fake message together. The fake text said: your account is suspended, verify your account, and enter your password within 2 hours. We are not asking you to do any of that. The reading is posted on https://canvas.northwind.edu/courses/301. Bring one observation about which sentence created the pressure.
